# Pie Square Technologies

Pie Square Technologies is an infrastructure and technology solutions company based in Lalitpur, Nepal.

## What the company does

- Telecom infrastructure, RF drive testing, network verification, and optimization
- Optical fiber route survey, deployment, splicing, testing, and maintenance
- Solar, electrical, hybrid power, and renewable-energy systems
- IT infrastructure, digital systems, and website content services
